name: run_finemapping
description: Bayesian statistical finemapping on GWAS summary statistics to compute posterior inclusion probabilities (PIPs) and 95% credible sets
usage: from app.tools.biomni.genetics import run_finemapping; result = run_finemapping('input/sumstats.tsv', n_causal=1, output_dir='output/')

parameters.sumstats_path: str — path to TSV summary statistics file with columns: snp, chr, pos, beta, se, pval, n
parameters.n_causal: int — expected number of causal variants per locus (default 1)
parameters.output_dir: str — directory to write finemapping results (default 'output/')

returns: dict with keys: n_variants_total, credible_set_size, top_variant, credible_set (list with pip scores), output_files
